clarification: The SQL 60..86400-second bound has an existing original contract. The prior review left this as a conditional source question; it is now resolved and is not a request for a new policy.
required_changes: Reject invalid/zero Clock values before SameAttempt equality.
Make NewOperationClock enforce the existing integer-second window 60..86400 while preserving the original operation creation/deadline, including its queue time.
Make the SQL operation-window CHECK enforce the same integer-second granularity, not only a microsecond BETWEEN range.
Cover 59s, 60s, 86400s, 86401s and 60s+1us, plus the zero/replay cases; this is not a new user policy decision.
